convert_stable_cascade_lite_weights: run the script to convert Stable Cascade model weights to a diffusers pipeline
convert_prior_stage_only: run the conversion script with --skip_stage_b to convert only the prior stage C model
convert_decoder_stage_only: run the conversion script with --skip_stage_c to convert only the decoder stage B model
save_combined_pipeline: run the conversion script with --save_combined to create a combined StableCascadeCombinedPipeline
push_converted_models_to_hub: run the conversion script with --push_to_hub to upload converted pipelines to the Hugging Face Hub
